description: This file contains implementation code for WiFi radio channel statistics collection and processing, including functions for validating arguments, generating keys, processing neighbor and channel stats, executing scans, and caching data. It is part of a WiFi monitoring system that interacts with hardware via specific APIs and manages data collection through scheduled tasks.

classes.name: radio_chan_data_t
classes.description: Structure representing data for a specific radio channel.

classes.name: wifi_channelStats_t
classes.description: Structure representing detailed WiFi channel statistics.

classes.name: wifi_mon_stats_args_t
classes.description: Arguments structure for WiFi monitoring statistical functions.

classes.name: wifi_provider_response_t
classes.description: Structure used for sending scan and stats responses to core/monitoring components.

classes.name: wifi_monitor_t
classes.description: Main data structure for WiFi monitoring system, containing stats, locks, and scheduled tasks.

classes.name: wifi_mon_collector_element_t
classes.description: Represents an element in the WiFi monitoring data collection process, including configuration and scheduling info.

methods.name: int validate_radio_channel_args(wifi_mon_stats_args_t * args)

methods.description: Generates a key string for radio channel collector stats based on arguments.

methods.name: int generate_radio_channel_provider_stats_key(wifi_mon_stats_config_t * config,char * key_str,size_t key_len)
methods.description: Generates a key string for provider-specific radio channel stats.

methods.description: Processes neighbor WiFi scan results into a structured format for reporting.

methods.description: Processes raw radio channel statistics into usable data structures.

methods.name: void copy_chanstats_to_chandata(radio_chan_data_t * chan_data,wifi_channelStats_t * chan_stats)
methods.description: Copies detailed channel statistics into a common data structure with timestamping.

methods.description: Stops scheduled tasks related to neighbor scanning for a radio channel.

methods.description: Main function to fetch, process, and report radio channel statistics.

methods.name: int retrigger_neighbor_scan(void * arg)
methods.description: Retries triggering a neighbor scan if the previous attempt failed, with retries and delays.

methods.description: Checks if neighbor scan results are ready, handles retries, and updates internal cache.

methods.description: Retrieves list of channels that are in NOP (Non-Operational)/CAC (Channel Availability Check) start state.

methods.description: Copies cached radio channel statistics for use in reports or further analysis.

methods.name: int update_radio_channels_collector_args(void * ce)
